verdict.comment: A chance is taken on last year's runner-up MONVIEL, for whom the returning cheekpieces could be a major positive.

comments.belowtheradar: Two novice wins early last year but hasn't threatened this season in first three handicaps
comments.blenkinsop: Prolific in h'caps in late 2022; signs of promise last month when back from long absence
comments.djodelabarriere: Fair fourth at Ludlow last time and a stronger pace could help in this bigger field
comments.hiddenhistory: Runner-up on second handicap start; makes debut for Dan Skelton; open to improvement
comments.jilaijone: Wide-margin C&D win in January and another big run when 4th at Ascot latest; thereabouts
comments.kahavari: Ex-French 5yo who could be suited by the step up in trip on handicap debut
comments.kamaxos: Attractively handicapped on his form last spring but hasn't been at same level this season
comments.lihyan: Better than ever in the autumn but returns from a break over a shorter trip today
comments.luckyone: Well handicapped on old form but well beaten on both runs this winter after long absence
comments.monviel: Struggling for form but well handicapped and the return of cheekpieces could help
comments.nowmelad: Two novice wins last autumn but soundly beaten in fourth on last month's handicap debut
comments.partybusiness: Pulled up the last twice but has had excuses and he's dropped to a dangerous mark
comments.statuario: Well treated on last year's chase form but questionable whether return to h'dles will suit
comments.wellingtonarch: Two-time novice winner who brings potential to handicap debut, especially now up in trip
comments.whatsupwithyou: 11yo who won at Ludlow last month; takes on unexposed types but has an each-way chance

races.raceComment: whatsupwithyou is marginally preferred with a score of 53.5%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This is seriously competitive. BLAZE THE WAY has been improving in Ireland and his latest second was over an inadequate 2m4f.

comments.backmersackme: Solid efforts in Listed handicaps in Ireland the last twice; cheekpieces added; likes soft
comments.blazetheway: Improving Irish raider who will appreciate returning to this longer trip; much respected
comments.castelfort: In deeper here over a longer trip but his trainer considers him a future staying chaser
comments.chasingouttheblues: Unlucky not to be closer in a good race at Haydock; on the upgrade and has a chance
comments.dartmoorpirate: Has to bounce back from a poor last run but better than that and not badly handicapped
comments.equinus: He's failed to complete in both chases for this yard and was 150-1 for the latest
comments.fingalshill: Has been running well this season but it doesn't get any easier here
comments.guardduty: Easy Newbury winner and could be progressive enough to handle the 10lb rise; should stay
comments.indianadream: Promising in Ireland but has shown nothing in two chases since joining current yard
comments.joyeuxmachin: Kept on for 2nd at Ascot and interesting now returned to further as he has won at 3m
comments.patriotik: Only his second attempt over this far under rules when staying on well to win at Doncaster
comments.phantomofthepoints: An improver this season at about 3m and cheekpieces go on after a lesser display at Exeter
comments.reddirtroad: Up the weights but very progressive and will run well if coping with the drying ground
comments.redrisk: Exposed but back on a better mark and latest closing third was after 261 days away
comments.samuelspade: Decisive winner at Ascot (2m7f) and jockey's claim takes care of 5lb of the 8lb rise
comments.strackan: His productive campaign has come at a cost mark-wise and only fifth at Exeter last time
comments.upforparol: Never threatened to defy this mark at Newbury and he's in another competitive race

races.raceComment: guardduty is marginally preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over reddirtroad. Won 2 of last 4 starts. Excellent course form of 4/8 at uttoxeter. Key attributes include strong course form and positive comments and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Classy mare APPLE AWAY (nap) should move with purpose for a long way and that can count for a lot in these competitive staying chases.

comments.anglerscrag: Four wins last season included the 4m1f Eider; hinted at a return to form on final start
comments.appleaway: Classy mare; unraced over this far but likely to remain in her comfort zone for a long way
comments.bodhisattva: Staying-on second in the Edinburgh National before unseating 7f out in the Eider
comments.egbert: Can run well again but others might be better equipped to see this out stronger
comments.fortunedefortunata: H'cap debut in this discipline when beating 16 rivals at Punchestown; may prefer the mud
comments.galiadesliteaux: Last year's Grand National 8th; fair run last time and she's easing in the weights
comments.invinciblenao: Recent wins have been at 3m1f/3m4f and he's unexposed as a stayer; lightly weighted
comments.ioupycollonges: Lightly raced chaser; unraced beyond 3m1f but he doesn't do much in a hurry
comments.ironbridge: Has his off days but a smart stayer who does have form here; tries blinkers
comments.knockanore: Easy winner of the Eider three weeks ago off 10lb lower; very unexposed as a stayer
comments.mrvango: Out-and-out stayer built to carry the weight but all his best form is in the mud
comments.mysilverlining: Former winner of Warwick's big staying chase but she's having a disappointing season
comments.passingwell: Consistent gelding but only 1lb lower than when a remote third in the Eider
comments.saintdavy: Lightly raced chaser; interesting if finding some rhythm and staying okay in new blinkers
comments.tanganyika: Improving and if his stamina reserves can stretch this far then he might not be far away
comments.valdancer: Would prefer softer ground ideally but lots to like otherwise after the season he's had
comments.whereitallbegan: Inconsistent but a 3m3f winner and ran well in the Welsh National until clouting four out

races.raceComment: mysilverlining is marginally preferred with a score of 61.2%, holding clear edges in more progressive over knockanore. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 5/18 at uttoxeter. Key attributes include strong course form, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Old rivals Coul Angel and LEADENHALL STREET can fight this out. The Fanshawe runner looked well ahead of his mark here last month.

comments.bluelakota: Won 3 of his last 4, latest over C&D; 2lb rise less of a concern than deeper opposition
comments.brosay: 5f win here on stable debut before a near miss over 6f at Lingfield; less good last time
comments.coulangel: Beat Leadenhall Street at Kempton & 6lb better off today; perhaps unsuited by track latest
comments.fanmail: Improving all the time and won decisively in a maiden latest; widest stall to overcome
comments.humam: 2-2 on AW this year, beating a subsequent Listed winner over C&D latest; big player up 6lb
comments.leadenhallstreet: Improving run by run and produced a smooth performance over C&D on h'cap debut; big chance
comments.lineofforce: C&D win in December was a good effort; not kicked on since and has a bit to prove
comments.midnightcity: Three good runs over C&D, 3rd behind Leadenhall Street latest; should run his race
comments.proudlyyours: Made winning debut (5f, AW) for G Lyons before being highly tried; hooded for h'cap debut
comments.theactor: Low-key stable debut (behind Humam) over C&D last month; wind op since; yard in fine form
comments.theflyingseagull: Prominent racer; weakened late at Lingfield on recent return; can do better this year
comments.ziggysariel: Two 6f wins as a 2yo, notably an AW nursery when last seen; this is tougher

races.raceComment: bluelakota is strongly preferred with a score of 60.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over leadenhallstreet. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 3/9 at southwell. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to ACES WILD who is weighted to reverse last month's C&D running with Maharajas Express and has the inside stall.

comments.aceswild: Triple C&D winner who is weighted to reverse last month's running with Maharajas Express
comments.angleseylad: 0-12 and needs a good deal more if he is to break his duck in this field
comments.basholo: Four wins over C&D, but has been a bit in and out lately and her wide draw is no help
comments.buraback: Won twice over C&D in January, but has it all to do from the outside stall this time
comments.coolaghmagic: Nine wins on the AW, but still 5lb above his last winning mark and not drawn to advantage
comments.generalassembly: Ran better than finishing position would suggest at Newcastle last time, but needs more
comments.maharajasexpress: Three wins over C&D and just beaten at Newcastle last time; major contender from same mark
comments.phoenixbeach: Record over C&D reads 23132321; each-way shout despite 5lb penalty
comments.reconmission: Losing run of 31 and an AW record of 1-24 makes him hard to support with confidence
comments.rosenpur: Finished behind two of these when last of ten here last month, but is better than that

races.raceComment: rosenpur is marginally preferred with a score of 59.8%. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This may be the day that TWO PLUS TWO doubles his winning tally having only just lost out in a handicap over C&D 12 days ago.

comments.cosmicview: Had three of these behind when off the mark in a similar event over C&D last month
comments.devore: Showed nothing in six starts (1m-2m) since the start of last year; best to look elsewhere
comments.disquietude: 0-12 and finished behind three of these over C&D 12 days ago; improvement required
comments.fandabidozi: Held in two starts here since returning last month, the latest on Wednesday; more needed
comments.honrado: 0-14; second to an in-form rival at Lingfield in January but disappointing there next time
comments.lednikov: Made all at Southwell last month and third over C&D last time; could run well again
comments.nationalhealth: 0-13 but runner-up here in his last three starts; doesn't need much more in order to win
comments.northsteadgardens: 0-12; well held in both starts here since returning for this yard in January; up in trip
comments.princehector: 2-34; has run well over C&D but will need to improve on recent efforts to win again
comments.twoplustwo: 1-21 but a close second over C&D 12 days ago; drops to this level for the first time
comments.walkthemoon: Third behind two of these over C&D last month; now 0-22 and needs to find a bit more

races.raceComment: fandabidozi is marginally preferred with a score of 46.8%, holding clear edges in more progressive over lednikov. Won 1 of last 6 starts.
